n4789adcbb6.headline: The national currency exchange rate may strengthen to 323 tenge per dollar this week - experts: May 16, 2016 15:26 - news on Tengrinews.kz
n4789adcbb6.summary: Experts forecast that Kazakhstan's national currency, the tenge, could strengthen to 323 tenge per US dollar during the week.
n4789adcbb6.why: Currency fluctuations affect trade, inflation, and investment flows in Kazakhstan, impacting companies and the broader economy.
